title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the scatterplot of the first two principal components. Notice how the points are grouped into three distinct clusters. These clusters represent different types of visitors based on their time spent at the exhibits.

title: Analyzing the First Row of $$V^T$$
text: The first row of $$V^T$$ shows the contribution of each exhibit to the first principal component. Look at which exhibits have the highest values in this row.

title: Analyzing the Second Row of $$V^T$$
text: The second row of $$V^T$$ shows the contribution of each exhibit to the second principal component. Identify which exhibits have the highest values in this row.

hintAnswer: These visitors spend a lot of time at the activities (train and playground).
title: Identifying the Top Group
text: Based on the plots of the first and second rows of $$V^T$$, which exhibits do the top group of visitors spend the most time at?
choices: These visitors spend a lot of time at the mammal exhibits (cheetah, tiger, and lion).
These visitors spend a lot of time at the activities (train and playground).
These visitors spend a lot of time at the reptile exhibits (turtle, iguana, and alligator).
These visitors spend very little time at any of the $$8$$ exhibits.
These visitors spend about the same amount of time at every exhibit.
